elements.caption: Without a selection, exactly one WoIst map with address resolution enabled on the same account is used. Multiple maps require an explicit selection.

actions.caption: Offline devices may play the sound later when they reconnect.

items.caption: Lost Mode locks the device and may suspend Apple Pay. Contact information appears on its Lock Screen. Offline devices may activate it later.
Leave the passcode empty to keep an existing device code. Only enter a new code if required; keep it safe to unlock the device. Contact data and code are not saved as settings.

items.name: ActivateLostMode
items.caption: Activate Lost Mode
items.confirm: Activate Lost Mode for the displayed device? This can lock it and suspend Apple Pay. The contact information will be sent to Apple and displayed on the device. Keep any new passcode safe. Offline devices may activate it later.

items.caption: Accepted Lost Mode requests do not confirm a completed change; the status variable follows the next account update.

items.name: DeactivateLostMode
items.caption: Deactivate Lost Mode
items.confirm: Deactivate Lost Mode for the displayed device? This ends Lost Mode protection. The device may remain locked; its passcode and Activation Lock are not removed. Offline devices may process the request later.

items.caption: Deactivation does not require the contact fields or a new passcode. It may also be requested before an earlier activation is confirmed. If Apple requires further steps, use Find My or unlock the device as described by Apple.

status.caption: Device not in current account list.
